title: Mandating Caregiving Leave for Private Sector Companies
what_it_is: Mandating Caregiving Leave for Private Sector Companies

sections.label: Employer caregiving leave support
sections.summary: Employers must provide paid maternity, paternity, childcare and unpaid infant care leave, and some voluntarily provide other paid caregiving leave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: All employers are required by law to provide paid maternity and paternity leave, as well as childcare and unpaid infant care leave to support the caregiving needs of employees with children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In addition, some employers have voluntarily provided other types of paid leave, such as parental care leave and family care leave, to support employees with other caregiving needs, such as caring for elderly or disabled family members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The tripartite partners also actively encourage employers to adopt best practices, such as providing enhanced leave benefits through the Tripartite Standards on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs and Tripartite Standards on Work-Life Harmony.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The range of caregiving responsibilities and methods of caregiving continue to vary and evolve.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will study and continue to review how to better support working caregivers, bringing alongside with us the private sector companies and working closely with our tripartite partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A more sustainable and flexible form of workplace support is flexible work arrangements, which allow caregivers to vary their work timing, location and workload to suit their personal circumstances.

sections.label: Private company leave provision
sections.summary: Only 20% of private companies provide this as a requirement, and caregiving needs are varied, so statutory leave is calibrated to balance employees and employers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Only 20% of private companies provide this as a requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It may be tough for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to provide this, but maybe for the larger companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We recognise that caregiving needs are varied and have taken a practical approach in calibrating the statutory leave provisions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Importantly, we want to strike good balance between employees' caregiving needs and employers' business costs and manpower needs.
